objective: Ensure the lightweight source-provenance probe runs on main pushes and full workflow dispatches instead of being silently skipped outside schedules or lightweight dispatches.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Scientific Validation run 38005546758 had Source provenance acquisition and scientific gate readiness skipped on a main-branch heavy run.
The job condition only allowed schedule or workflow_dispatch with run_heavy=false, so successful heavy evidence did not include a provenance probe.
CPVS exact-membership mismatch remains unresolved and the product-level scientific gate must remain fail-closed.

baseline.status: The source-provenance job ran only on schedules or workflow_dispatch with run_heavy=false.

expected_improvement: Run source provenance probe on main pushes.
Run source provenance probe on all workflow_dispatch events, including full heavy runs.
Keep source probe separate from and non-substitutive for scientific release gate evidence.

correctness.before: Main push and full heavy dispatch skipped the source provenance probe.
correctness.after: Condition includes schedule, all workflow_dispatch events, and pushes to main.

evidence: Required PR checks and a main-push source-probe run are pending.

root_causes: Workflow job if-condition excluded push events to main and workflow_dispatch with run_heavy=true.

findings: A green heavy workflow does not establish source-provenance readiness if that job is skipped.
Job skip conditions should be visible in workflow evidence and tested against intended event types.

open_blockers: Verify source-provenance job runs on main push and full workflow dispatch.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep CPVS exact membership UNRESOLVED until independently reproduced.
Do not weaken the product scientific release gate.
Run provenance probes alongside heavy evidence acquisition on main.
